question.text:
How many of these compounds can reduce Tollen's reagent here?

HCHO,Ph-CHO,Ph-COCH3,CH3COCH3,CH3-C||O-CH2OH , Glucose, CH3CH2OH

solution.text: <math><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">h</mi><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mo>-</mo><munder><mrow><munder><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mo>|</mo></mrow></munder></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow></munder><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></math>  and Glucose can reduce Tollen's reagent.
